cards.card_text: Then they add their own plea: "So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father."

cards.card_text: So Moses prays, quoting what the LORD declared: "The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression." He quotes the other half too: the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished.
cards.verse_text: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression.
cards.snippet: …is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression.

cards.card_text: Near the end, Job asks God why He does not pardon his transgression and take away his iniquity.
